title: The Far Star
subtitle: hideUntilDependenciesVisible
description: `hideUntilDependenciesVisible` hides this node until at least one of its prerequisites is itself visible. The rule is recursive, and the farther star below hangs off this one — so the chain reveals itself one link at a time from its first visible end, which is the one reveal that cannot be read off a single file.
Its name is drawn, which is one of the few `showTitle` nodes on the canvas.
